receipt.scope: Immutable container configuration and pinned direct executable; no independent kernel execution trace

eager_graph_mode.scope: Immutable container configuration plus pinned source semantics; no independent kernel execution trace.
eager_graph_mode.source_semantics: Commissioning evidence documents cuda_native.zig:117 selects eager mode by environment variable presence; TF_GLM_EAGER=0 would still select eager. No --eager CLI claim.

proof_limits: Supplemental cases, not the unpublished upstream 17/4/428/56 fixtures.
No code is executed and no quality, full-context, sustained-capacity or reboot qualification is established.
Client request intervals can overlap without proving simultaneous backend decoding.
Closing an SSE connection does not prove when the backend retired its work; subsequent requests test usability only.
Cache counts are provider observations; a zero count is not proof of universally cold state.
Needle sizing tokenizes raw text; actual chat-template prompt tokens are retained separately.
Needle assertion checks required-value presence; forced128 ignore_eos output continues with visible role/thinking markers. This gate does not establish clean exact-answer quality.
Initial *-request.json ok=false records are pre-dispatch snapshots; all31 settled final-result files independently verify.

sustained_load.aggregate_metric_definition: Pinned cmd_sustained spreads each reply token count evenly across its client decode span, clips contributions to the fixed 90-second dispatch window, then divides by90. This is a modeled client window rate, not direct token-arrival counting or guaranteed steady capacity.
sustained_load.window_reconstruction_limit: Exact scheduled t_start is not retained in raw JSONL; reconstruction uses earliest observed request start and reproduces rounded156.51.
